line: Here's a separate test run with a failing return policy. Ask the agent to improve it.
Your editor can evolve, too. Ask your coding agent to add a missing editor tool.
For example: add a tool to export this agent's diagnostics.
With a local, source-linked plugin, the agent can update the code, run checks, rebuild, and reload the editor in place.
An editor issue follows the same loop: reproduce it, repair the code, verify the fix, and reload.
No uninstall. No reinstall. Keep working with your improved editor.
